A heading whose space-separated classes include `no-toc` still gets its id (generated through `unique`, so `contents`, `contents_1`, ...), anchors and permalinks, but is not appended to `toc_tokens`. Because the TOC markup and `md.toc_tokens` are both built from that list, one check satisfies FR-001 to FR-003.
